shadowQuality.tooltip:
Shadow quality determines which objects cast realistic shadows.

On lower settings, the shadows of smaller objects are disabled to improve performance.
generalDetailLevel.tooltip:
Detail level determines a trade-off between overall graphics quality and performance.

On lower settings, the animation quality of small and far away objects is decreased to improve performance.
simulationAccuracy.tooltip: Lowering simulation accuracy can increase performance in very large aquariums. You might find things react to changes slightly slower than usual.
multiThreadedRendering.label: MULTI-THREADED RENDERING     <color=#ffb300FF>(EXPERIMENTAL)</color>
multiThreadedRendering.tooltip:
Turning on multi-threaded rendering can dramatically increase frame rate in large aquariums on multi-core CPUs. The trade-off is a slight increase in animation latency (delay).

Recommendation: Turn on this option if you are consistently experiencing FPS below 60 and have a multi-core CPU. Otherwise leave it off.
uiAccuracy.tooltip: Lowering user interface (UI) accuracy will increase performance if you find the game slows down when many windows are open.
lightingQuality.tooltip: Disabling lighting can be used in extreme circumstances to increase performance at the cost of graphical fidelity. (Use as last resort)
antialiasing.label: ANTI-ALIASING
antialiasing.tooltip:
Anti-aliasing makes the edges of objects look smoother but takes extra graphical processing.

Disable to improve performance on low-end GPUs.

easyDifficulty:
Easy difficulty. Choose this if you want a relaxed experience or if you haven't played many strategy games before.

Capital costs: 50% lower.
Animal food and salaries: 33% lower.
Animal fragility: Low.
Animal eat each other chance: Low.
Breakdown rate: Low.
Prestige generation: 10% higher.
normalDifficulty: Normal difficulty. This is the standard game difficulty. Choose this if you have played stategy games before.
hardDifficulty:
Hard difficulty. For experienced strategy game players, choose this option if you want a challenge. You will need to manage your staff and spending efficiently.

Capital costs: 50% higher.
Animal food and salaries: 70% higher.
Animal fragility: Above average.
Animal eat each other chance: Above average.
Breakdown rate: Above average.
Prestige generation: 5% lower.
brutalDifficulty:
Brutal difficulty. Choose this if you want a punishing experience. Even small mistakes will be punished and running your aquarium at a profit will need your full attention.

Capital costs: 100% higher.
Animal food and salaries: 150% higher.
Animal fragility: High.
Animal eat each other chance: High.
Breakdown rate: High.
Prestige generation: 5% lower.

An error occurred during the loading process.

Mods have been detected, but due the setting 'dontDisableModsOnFailedLoad' in gui.data mods will not be disabled. To get the game to function you may need to manually disable the mod causing the issue.
loadSuccessfulAfterModsDisabledText:
